title: I don't have many players, but building games for friends with Opus it's just too much fun to stop
author: Dull-Ad-4826
selftext:
It started as a fun project for my group of friends because we like playing a modified version of "flunkyball" we call "plumki". They really liked it, and we have been playing it almost every day for the last 2 months. The feeling of creating something that your friends like and have fun with is just amazing. My friends are the biggest fans and they constantly ask for weird maps or in-game inside jokes. Even though there are around 10 people playing, I feel like I've developed something big.

I've started using Astra, but when Opus 5.5 came, I've almost entirely rebuilt it - it's that much better in my opinion. It's crazy to see that Opus 5.5 can write almost every model using mathematical functions. Everything you see in the video is coming from code 🤯

Not many people are playing it, but I had so much fun building, that now I have more maps than players 😂. Tbh, I think this is so empowering that it's now possible to create games just for yourself and your group of friends. If others like it, great, but it's not the end of the world if only they have fun playing it. It's still hard to create something good and requires a lot of work, but I wouldn't have thought it would ever be possible.

Has anyone found themselves opening a game studio for their friend group as well? I would love to see other friend-focused projects.
